message.content:
The cover of Tempo magazine features an illustration against a stylized sunrise or sunset sky of orange, pink, and yellow hues. In the foreground, the dark silhouettes of two figures are visible from behind, framing the scene. In the center, a round man wearing a grey safari-style suit with four pockets stands with his arms outstretched and mouth open. Behind him, two red buses are parked. A woman with dark hair and glasses, wearing a dark top with a red collar, stands on the steps of the bus on the right, holding onto a vertical handrail. The buses have dark windows and large black tires. The ground is a flat, light brown surface.

Text at the top includes "TEMPO" in large red letters, and "POROS BARU DEMOKRAT" in large black letters. Smaller text includes "Kerumitan Baru Pendirian Rumah Ibadah H.32", "Kisruh Harga Gas Industri H.70", and a paragraph beginning "Hengkang dari koalisi pengusung Anies Baswedan..." and ending "H.24". A barcode and QR code are in the upper right corner.
